name: Tirhana
title: Son of Caleb through his concubine Maaka
summary: Tirhana was a son of Caleb (son of Hezron) through his concubine Maaka. He is mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of the lineage of the tribe of Judah. His biblical significance lies primarily in his place in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Tirhanna is listed as a son of Caleb through his concubine Maacah in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's descendants through Maacah
keyEvents.description: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore several sons, including Tirhanna and Shaaph, who became part of the lineage of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's lineage in Judah
keyEvents.description: Caleb's descendants, including Tirhanna, formed an important part of the tribe of Judah and settled in various cities in the Promised Land.

keyEvents.title: Part of Hezron's lineage
keyEvents.description: Through his father Caleb, son of Hezron, Tirhanna belonged to a prominent family line within the tribe of Judah that played a significant role in Israel's history.
